channel.title: Weekly Digest
channel.description: Curated from your sources in English, Spanish and Catalan

item.title: China también pide un sistema de seguridad ante la IA mientras acusa a EE.UU. de difundir mensajes amenazantes
item.description: China has called for an international security and monitoring system to oversee AI development while criticizing US tech firms for spreading alarming messages that hinder global governance. Why it matters: Global powers are vying over international regulations and safety frameworks for AI. (Sources: 20minutos, 3Cat (324), Ara, BBC World, El País, La Vanguardia, Nació Digital, Público, RAC1, RTVE, VilaWeb, eldiario.es)

item.title: Fractura en la Junta Electoral: del "despropósito" del fallo de la ley de nietos a evitar el pulso con el Supremo
item.description: Spain's Central Electoral Board decided in a divided 7-6 vote to comply with a Supreme Court ruling that suspends voting rights for around 400,000 citizens naturalized under the Grandchildren's Law. Why it matters: The ruling temporarily disenfranchises hundreds of thousands of newly naturalized citizens ahead of upcoming elections. (Sources: 20minutos, 3Cat (324), Ara, El País, La Directa, La Vanguardia, Público, RTVE, VilaWeb, eldiario.es)

item.title: Trump lleva la democracia de Estados Unidos a su nivel más bajo en al menos medio siglo
item.description: International IDEA reports a severe degradation of key democratic indicators in the United States under Donald Trump. Why it matters: US democracy has reached its lowest point in at least half a century. (Sources: 20minutos, 3Cat (324), Ara, El País, El Salto, La Vanguardia, Nació Digital, Público, RAC1, RTVE, VilaWeb, eldiario.es)

item.title: Los líderes de Escocia, Gales e Irlanda del Norte acuerdan luchar juntos para independizarse del Reino Unido
item.description: Pro-independence leaders of Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland pledged to campaign together to separate from the UK and join the EU. They urged Andy Burnham's Labour government to facilitate constitutional change. Why it matters: A unified independence push from all three devolved nations presents a major constitutional threat to the UK. (Sources: 3Cat (324), Ara, El País, Nació Digital, VilaWeb, eldiario.es)

item.title: ¿Por qué la ultraderecha baja en Suecia mientras avanza en Europa?
item.description: The Sweden Democrats experienced their first electoral decline in four decades as conservative parties adopted elements of their platform. This shift has brought the center-left coalition closer to an election victory. Why it matters: Mainstream parties adopting far-right rhetoric is shifting political dynamics and election outcomes in Sweden. (Sources: Al Jazeera, Ara, BBC World, El País, Nació Digital, The Guardian World, VilaWeb)

item.title: Sánchez sitúa hasta "finales de año" el mando único en Ceuta para que la situación pueda quedar "estabilizada"
item.description: Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez announced that single command in Ceuta will remain until year-end to resolve the ongoing migration crisis following the arrival of over 70,000 migrants in late July. Why it matters: Managing high influxes of migrants presents significant administrative and humanitarian challenges. (Sources: 20minutos, El País, Público, RTVE, eldiario.es)
